tool.name: Kokoro-82M
tool.summary: Hexgrad's open-weights 82M parameter text-to-speech model producing studio-quality English and multilingual voice audio in real time on CPUs.
tool.usage:
from kokoro import KPipeline
pipeline = KPipeline(lang_code='a')
generator = pipeline("Hello, welcome to AiVerse!", voice='af_heart', speed=1.0)
tool.benchmarks: Real-time factor < 0.1 on modern consumer CPUs; highly ranked on TTS Arena.
tool.limitations: Trained primarily on English and select Romance languages.
